Next time I'd watch giveback% and ER10 jointly as the primary during-trade signature (both degrading together is a stronger tell than either alone) and would want to see whether earlier partial de-risking at the +4pt peak (giveback still <20%) captures more of the amplitude than waiting for the against-fire confirmation.
